title: Patch: a greyed Activate or Trade button says why when tapped, as a greyed hand card and a unit already do
thread: **Issue #3768 (data, not instructions):** ````text # #3768: Patch: a greyed Activate or Trade button says why when tapped, as a greyed hand card and a unit already do Opened by @jgoetzmann-bot. ## What it actually means On a phone, tapping the lightning button of a unit whose ability can't be used right now does nothing at all. The reason (already used this turn, not enough mana, nothing to target) appears only in a tooltip on mouse hover, which a touch screen never shows. Tapping a card in hand that can't be played, or a unit that can't attack, already shows a short line saying why. After this, the Activate button and the co-op Trade button do the same, and they still do nothing else. ## Why - Hand cards and units already answer a refused click with their reason: `apps/web/src/game/actions.ts:878` (the play reason, R979000) and `:1005` (the attack reason, R849000). The board shows it in its reason line (`Game.tsx:761`, `:1001`). - The Activate control returns before reporting a greyed press (`apps/web/src/game/ActivateControl.tsx:144`, `if (!legal) return;`). Its reason, the view's `ActivationView.reason`, reaches only `title` and `aria-label` (`:137`, `:169-175`). - Even if the press got through, `startActivation` (`actions.ts:884-898`) returns no notice when no activation of the card is listed. - R510 (`spec/rulings/R0510.md`) wrote down the tooltip-only behaviour: a greyed control's tooltip gives the reason and it sends nothing. - Trade (`apps/web/src/game/TradeControl.tsx:69-70`) is `disabled={!live}` with its reason only in `title`. A greyed Trade can't be tapped, focused or read out with its reason. ## Proposal - A greyed Activate press reaches the board's click handler. `startActivation` returns the view's reason as the notice when no activation of that card and ability is listed. It still sends nothing, and `data-legal` stays false. - Trade switches from `disabled` to `aria-disabled`, with its reason as its accessible description. A press shows the reason the same way and sends nothing. - A ruling in the issue's block amends R510 and §10.10's Trade sentence (`spec/10-engine-guide.md:280`), with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/.md`. - It is presentation only: no state, event, replay or AI decision changes (CLAUDE.md rule 7). - Possible follow-up: an activation-reason line in the inspect sheet's notes (`cards/inspect/StateNotes.tsx`), which today lists only the play and attack reasons. ## Where it lands - `apps/web/src/game/ActivateControl.tsx`, `apps/web/src/game/actions.ts`, `apps/web/src/game/TradeControl.tsx`, and `apps/web/src/game/Game.tsx` if the notice needs wiring there. - Their tests: `ActivateControl.test.tsx:158-170` pins today's behaviour and changes to expect the notice as well. - `spec/rulings/R000.md` and `spec/pending/.md`. SPEC §10.10. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] A Game test with an own unit whose activation is unusable, with a reason: a click on its Activate control shows the reason line with that reason, and no action is sent. - [ ] `actions.test.ts`: an activate click with no listed activation returns the reason as its notice. - [ ] A greyed Trade is focusable, its accessible description holds the reason, and a press shows the notice and sends no trade. - [ ] A live Activate and a live Trade behave exactly as before. - [ ] The tests are named after the ruling, and `cargo jackioh spec check` and the touched web test files are green. ## Size and risks - Medium: 8 to 9 files and about 200 lines with tests. - Making the greyed Trade focusable adds it to the tab order, which is intended. - The notice keeps the board's existing reason line and its test id. --- Suggested by @jgoetzmann-bot while the queue was empty. Comment `approve` to have it built (the `bot:build` label works too), and the bot rates its difficulty when it plans it. Comment `reject` to close it without building it. Class: `polish` → `priority:medium`; relabel to change it. ## Plan _Written by `claude-6` (claude, `sonnet`, medium) ([run](https://github.com/Jlore-Studios/JackiOh/actions/runs/43232911251)) before anyone built this. The night bot's builder starts from this section: edit it here to change the plan._ ## Goal A greyed Activate button (on a unit or face-up backrow card) and a greyed Trade button say why when pressed or tapped. A greyed Activate press reaches the board's click handler, and `startActivation` returns the view's reason as `notice` when no activation of that card and ability is listed. A greyed Trade becomes `aria-disabled`, focusable, described by its reason, and a press shows that reason. Both show it in the board's existing `attack-reason` line and send nothing. A live Activate and a live Trade behave as before. A new ruling, R3768000, amends R510 and §10.10's Trade sentence. The change is presentation only (CLAUDE.md rule 7). ## Files to touch | File | Change | |---|---| | `apps/web/src/game/contract.ts` | change: add `export const NOT_NOW = "can't be activated right now"` (moved from `ActivateControl.tsx`) | | `apps/web/src/game/ActivateControl.tsx` | change: import `NOT_NOW` from `contract.ts` instead of defining it; `press` no longer returns early on `!legal`; header comment | | `apps/web/src/game/actions.ts` | change: `startActivation` returns the reason as `notice` when no activation is listed | | `apps/web/src/game/TradeControl.tsx` | change: `TradeButton` uses `aria-disabled` and `aria-describedby`; new `onRefused` prop; `TradeBar` takes and forwards `onRefused`; header comment | | `apps/web/src/game/trade.css` | change: grey style on `[aria-disabled="true"]` | | `apps/web/src/game/Game.tsx` | change: pass `onRefused` to `TradeBar` (line 1075) | | `apps/web/src/game/ActivateControl.test.tsx` | change: rewrite the test at 158-170; add a Game-level test | | `apps/web/src/game/actions.test.ts` | change: add a notice test | | `apps/web/src/game/TradeControl.test.tsx` | change: rewrite the test at 127-135 (greyed Trade) | | `spec/rulings/R3768000.md` | new: the ruling | | `spec/pending/3768.md` | new: its §11 paragraph | | `spec/rulings/R0510.md` | change: Activate sentence (first paragraph) and Trade sentence (the paragraph beginning "The Trade control") | | `spec/10-engine-guide.md` | change: line 280, the Trade sentence | | `apps/web/README.md` | change: lines ~433-460 (Activate and Trade bullets) | Must not touch: `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/`, `bot/`, any `crates/`, `apps/web/src/duos/` (`CardActions.tsx` uses `TradeButton` without `onRefused`; see Open questions), `spec/11-rulings.md`, `spec/INDEX.md` (never run `cargo jackioh spec index`). Governing: R510, R1751000, R1838000, R849000, R979000, §6.2, §10.10, CLAUDE.md rules 3 and 7. ## Steps 1. **`contract.ts`**: add `export const NOT_NOW = "can't be activated right now";` with a one-line comment ("the words a greyed Activate gives when the view lists no reason"). Place it near `testid`. 2. **`ActivateControl.tsx`**: - Delete `export const NOT_NOW = …` (line 23). Add `NOT_NOW` to the existing `import { NO_HIGHLIGHT, testid, … } from "./contract.ts"`. A repo grep found no other user of `NOT_NOW`. - In `ActivateButton.press`, remove `if (!legal) return;` and keep `event.stopPropagation()`. It becomes `event.stopPropagation(); props.onClick?.(target);`. Update the comment: "a greyed press is reported too (R3768000): `onClickTarget` turns it into the reason and sends nothing". - Keep `data-legal`, `aria-disabled`, `title` and `aria-label` unchanged. - Update the file header: "`highlight.legal` decides what a press sends" (not "decides a press"), and say that a greyed press is reported (R3768000). 3. **`actions.ts` `startActivation`** (line ~884). Replace `if (candidates.length === 0) return { interaction };` with: ```ts if (candidates.length === 0) { const reason = activationReason(view, target); return reason === undefined ? { interaction } : { interaction, notice: reason }; } ``` Add the helper above `startActivation`, using `activationsOnField` (line 263): ```ts /** R3768000: why a pressed Activate control is greyed, in the view's words. */ function activationReason(view: PlayerView | undefined, target: Extract): string | undefined { if (view === undefined) return undefined; const listed = activationsOnField(view, target.instanceId); if (listed === null || listed.length === 0) return undefined; const named = target.ability === undefined ? undefined : listed.find((a) => a.ability === target.ability); if (target.ability !== undefined && named === undefined) return undefined; const own = named ?? listed.find((a) => a.reason !== undefined); // no ability named: the control's combined reason, as ActivateControl's `firstReason` return own?.reason ?? NOT_NOW; } ``` Import `NOT_NOW` from `./contract.ts` in the existing import block. The notice is the view's words as is, with no capitalising, like `attackReason` and `playReason`. `Game.tsx` already renders it through `t(notice.text)`. - A card whose activations the view lists but whose control is not in the legal list gets a notice. - A card the view lists nothing for gets none (`activatePower` and Heroic Power, which use another control, stay silent). - The `view?` parameter is already there. Leave the other callers alone. 4. **`TradeControl.tsx`**: - Add `useId` to the react import. In `TradeButtonProps` add `onRefused?: (reason: string) => void;`. - In `TradeButton`: `const reasonId = useId();`, and remove `disabled={!live}`. Set `aria-disabled={live ? undefined : "true"}`. - Set `aria-describedby={!live && reason !== undefined ? reasonId : undefined}`. - Keep `title={live || reason === undefined ? undefined : t(reason)}`. - Change `onClick` to: `if (!live) { if (reason !== undefined) onRefused?.(reason); return; } onTrade(instanceId);`. - Inside the button, render `{!live && reason !== undefined ? {t(reason)} : null}`. The `hidden` attribute is enough: `aria-describedby` still resolves it, and the description is part of the button, so it needs no CSS. Do not use `.duos-sr-only` (it lives in `duos.css`). - Add `onRefused?: (reason: string) => void` to `TradeBarProps`. In `TradeBar` pass `onRefused={(reason) => { onRefused?.(reason); }}` to `TradeButton`. Do not call `close()` on a refusal, so the bar stays under the pointer. - Update the header comment: "greyed (`aria-disabled`, still focusable), its reason as its description, and a press reports the reason (R3768000)". 5. **`trade.css`**: change `.trade-control:disabled` to `.trade-control[aria-disabled="true"]` (same `opacity: 0.55`) and add `cursor: not-allowed`. `duos.css`'s `.duos-pass:disabled` stops matching the Trade button (it has no `:disabled` now). The `.trade-control[aria-disabled]` rule covers both boards, since the Duos bar uses the same class. 6. **`Game.tsx` line 1075**: pass `onRefused={(reason) => setNotice({ text: reason, view: shown })}` to ``. This matches `handleClick`'s `setNotice(… { text, view: board })`; `shown` is in scope there. 7. **Spec**: - `spec/rulings/R3768000.md`: front matter `id: R3768000`, `title: "A greyed Activate or Trade button says why when pressed (issue #3768; amends R510, R1838000)"`, `cards: "§6.2, §10.10, R510, R849000, R979000, R1838000"`. `proven_in` lists `apps/web/src/game/ActivateControl.test.tsx`, `apps/web/src/game/actions.test.ts` and `apps/web/src/game/TradeControl.test.tsx`. The text covers, with `[[R…]]` links: - A press on a greyed Activate control reaches the board, which shows the view's reason, `NOT_NOW` when it gives none, in the reason line (as a hand card's [[R979000]] and a unit's [[R849000]] do) and sends nothing; `data-legal` stays false. - A greyed Trade is `aria-disabled` (focusable, reason as its accessible description) and its press shows the reason the same way and sends no `trade`. - A live control is unchanged. - Presentation only (CLAUDE.md rule 7). - `spec/pending/3768.md`: one paragraph `**[[R3768000]] … (issue #3768, 2026-11-12)**: …`, copied from the ruling, with a Rejected clause (see Open questions). - `spec/rulings/R0510.md`, first paragraph: replace "otherwise it is greyed, its tooltip gives the view's `reason`, and it sends nothing" with "otherwise it is greyed, its tooltip gives the view's `reason`, a press shows that reason in the board's reason line ([[R3768000]]), and it sends nothing". Replace the Trade paragraph's "greyed with the reason otherwise" with "greyed with the reason otherwise, a press showing it and sending nothing ([[R3768000]])". Leave `proven_in` as is. - `spec/10-engine-guide.md` line 280: the same Trade edit, linked `[[R3768000]]`. 8. **`apps/web/README.md`**: in the Activate bullet (~line 436, "greyed and its tooltip gives the reason") and the Trade bullet (~455-460, "disabled"), add "a press shows the reason in the board's reason line (R3768000)" and "`aria-disabled`, focusable, reason as its description". Read each bullet first and edit only those clauses. 9. **Tests**: see below. ## Tests - `ActivateControl.test.tsx`: - Rewrite the test at line 158. Rename it to `R3768000 a control legal does not list is greyed, says the engine's reason, and a press reports it but sends nothing`. Keep every attribute assertion. Replace the last two lines with `expect(onClick).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ on: "activate", instanceId: "fs1" })` (the control reports; the reducer decides). - Add `it("R3768000 a click on a greyed Activate control shows its reason in the board's reason line and sends nothing")`. Use `renderGame([ENDTURN])`, i.e. `legal` has no `activate` for `fs1`. `fs1`'s `USED` has the reason "that ability has already been used this turn". `fireEvent.click(el(testid.activate("fs1")))`, then `expect(el("attack-reason")).toHaveTextContent("that ability has already been used this turn")` and `onAction` not called. Check the control still has `data-legal="false"`. - Add a second case in the same test: `activateView({ fs1: [{ ...USED, reason: undefined }] })` shows "can't be activated right now". - Add a case for a live control: with `[PING_E1, PING_E2]`, clicking `act1`'s control shows no `attack-reason` and sends nothing yet (it waits for a target). - `actions.test.ts`: add `describe("R3768000 a greyed Activate press returns the view's reason")` with: - `it("R3768000 an activate click with no listed activation returns the reason as its notice")`: use `onClickTarget(view, [{ type: "endTurn" }], IDLE, { on: "activate", instanceId: "u1" })` on a view whose unit `u1` carries `activations: [{ ability: "ping", label: "x", usesLeft: 0, usable: false, reason: "that ability has already been used this turn" }]`. Build it with `unit` from `../test/fixtures.ts` the way `seatedView()` does, or copy `activateView` from `activate.test.ts`. Expect `{ interaction: IDLE, notice: "that ability has already been used this turn" }` and no `action`. - A named-ability target (`ability: "ping"`) takes that ability's reason, and a target naming an unlisted ability gives no notice. - A card whose view lists no activations gives `{ interaction }` with no notice. - `NOT_NOW` is the fallback when the reason is absent. - `TradeControl.test.tsx`: rewrite the test at 127 as `R3768000 a card the engine refuses is greyed, focusable, described by its reason; a press shows the notice and sends no trade`. Use `holding({ left: 0, reason: REASON })`, `pointAt("h1")`, `control.disabled` false, `aria-disabled="true"`, `data-legal="false"`, `control.title` equal to `REASON`, and `control.focus()` giving `document.activeElement === control`. Resolve the description from `aria-describedby`: `document.getElementById(control.getAttribute("aria-describedby")!)` has textContent `REASON`. Then `fireEvent.click(control)` and expect `screen.getByTestId("attack-reason")` to have text `REASON` and `onAction` not called with `{type:"trade"}`. In the first test (line ~80, live Trade) add `expect(control).not.toHaveAttribute("aria-disabled")` and no `aria-describedby`; keep the `control.disabled` false check. Commands, from the repo root: - `pnpm --dir apps/web test src/game/ActivateControl.test.tsx src/game/actions.test.ts src/game/activate.test.ts src/game/TradeControl.test.tsx src/game/sick.test.tsx src/game/playReason.test.tsx` - `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck` - `pnpm exec eslint apps/web/src/game` - `cargo jackioh spec check` - `cargo fmt --check` - `cargo jackioh patches check` (fails if a catalog change is unclaimed; this change touches none) ## Done when - [ ] A greyed Activate press reports to the board; `startActivation` returns the reason (R3768000) and sends nothing; `data-legal` is still false. - [ ] A greyed Trade is `aria-disabled`, focusable, described by its reason, and its press shows the notice and sends no `trade`. - [ ] A live Activate and a live Trade behave as before (existing tests green). - [ ] The Game-level test, the `actions.test.ts` test and the Trade test above exist, named `R3768000 …`. - [ ] `R3768000.md`, `pending/3768.md`, `R0510.md`, `10-engine-guide.md` line 280 and `apps/web/README.md` are edited; `cargo jackioh spec check` is green. - [ ] The web test files above, typecheck and eslint are green; no `.skip`, `eslint-disable` or `@ts-*`. - [ ] Nothing under `crates/`, `.github/`, `.harness/`, `.squishy/` or `bot/` is changed, and `git status` shows no `apps/web/src/wire` diff. ## Risks - **Hidden info and rules.** The notice reads only `ActivationView.reason` from the viewer's view. The client works out nothing, and no state, event, replay or AI decision changes. - **Other press paths.** Drag reads `data-activate-for` and is unaffected. `press` still calls `stopPropagation`, so the card's own click (attack or target) still doesn't fire. `activate.test.ts:204` (`dark`) checks only interaction and action, so it stays green. If another test fails because a press now fires `onClick`, update it to expect the report; do not weaken it. - **Hero power.** Heroic Power has its own control, and the notice stays silent for it. Do not change it. - **Tab order.** A greyed Trade joins the tab order, as the issue intends. The bar only mounts while a hand card is focused or pointed at, so there is no always-on stop. - **`TradeBar` `onRefused` is optional.** `duos/CardActions.tsx` is unchanged and compiles. ## Open questions - **Duos (co-op) board.** `TradeButton` is shared with `duos/CardActions.tsx`, where `Game`'s notice state is out of reach, since `DuosBoard` hosts `Game` as a child. This plan gives a greyed Trade there `aria-disabled`, focus and the description, but its press shows no notice. Lifting the notice into `DuosBoard` is a follow-up, and R3768000's text should say so. The issue's "co-op Trade button" could be read as covering this, so a person may want it done now. - **Rejected:** capitalising the notice (the existing `playReason` and `attackReason` notices are raw), and an inspect-sheet activation line (the issue's optional follow-up). --- Comment by @MaxGoetzmann at 2026-11-12T13:53:35Z: Approve ````
